title: Answer
description:
If we sin willfully after receiving the knowledge of the truth, no sacrifice for sins remains. That willful sin is the sin of a high hand, not the unintended fault for which an offering was provided.

Under the first word, two or three witnesses brought death without mercy. To trample the Son of God, to count the blood of the covenant a common thing, and to insult the Spirit of grace, is worse, because the Speaker and the blood are greater.

Vengeance belongs to God, and He Himself will judge His people. The warning that once stood over that people is now set over this one.
